newsitem.title: CHINA: China tells dissident family to hire lawyer.
newsitem.headline: China tells dissident family to hire lawyer.

text.p: Chinese court officials on Thursday told the family of detained dissident and former student leader Wang Dan that they should hire a lawyer on his behalf, his mother said.
"They may be preparing for a hearing," his mother, Wang Lingyun, told Reuters by telephone.
"They wouldn't say anything else," she said.
The Beijing People's Intermediate Court informed her that she had until Friday to find a lawyer, in a sign that a trial of Wang was imminent.
"I still haven't found one...the deadline is too close," she said.
Chinese sources have said Wang faces a prison term of up to seven years on charges of counter-revolutionary incitement, or sedition.
